visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white ribbed tank top, stands in a room with a plain, off-white wall. She holds a white paper with handwritten blue text and points a black pen at it. Her expression is calm yet focused as she gazes into the lens, gesturing with the pen. (2) The camera cuts to a similar framing, but the woman now grips a matte black handgun. She uses her left hand to pull back the slide of the firearm with a swift, forceful motion. Her eyes narrow into a fierce, aggressive squint while her mouth sets in a hard line. (3) The woman continues holding the gun, looking briefly to the side before refocusing her gaze back on the camera. The background remains the same neutral wall with flat lighting. Her body is tense and her posture is assertive as she gestures slightly with the weapon while maintaining an intense gaze.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in Mandarin Chinese with a friendly yet informative tone. She maintains a moderate speech rate and conversational pitch. There is no background music, and the recording has a clean indoor room tone with very little environmental noise or interference. (2) A loud, percussive metallic mechanical click occurs, characterized by a sharp transient and short spectral bandwidth. Simultaneously, the female vocal shifts to a much lower pitch and aggressive tone. The speech becomes intense and deliberate, delivered with high dominance and lowered volume. No music is present.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous skit aimed at subverting viewer expectations. It starts by posing a common relationship issue (jealousy over social media) in a calm, instructional format, only to pivot to a dramatic, aggressive, and exaggerated 'solution' involving a prop firearm to create comedic shock.
